async function callBoxApi(code) {
  try {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("code", code);

    const res = await fetch("/Cover/SecureBoxCode", {
      method: "POST",
      body: formData
    });

    if (!res.ok) return false;

    const json = await res.json();

    if (json.result === true) {
      BOX_DATA = json.data;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    return false;
  }
}
